Root cause constraint/flow: the route SDC io_vclk_m_770 is the SS-era insertion (routed TT boundary insertion 581, 488..768), so the route saw ~190 ps of output credit that sign-off removes, and HM 45 padded the outputs past the budget. h1ol (output latch) bench failed lockstep (21,373/40,000; TB samples at posedge). Fix: calibrate AND route at TC, io_vclk_m_<calibrated TT mean> generated in-stage (route sees the sign-off reference), H1 SDCs from main, link budget; LVT <=2% + mm FF hold HM 25. 0 cycles.
